title: Alternating Current Direct Current
definition: Direct Current (DC) is the unidirectional flow of electric charge, while Alternating Current (AC) is the periodic reversal of the direction of charge flow. These represent the two fundamental modes of electrical energy transmission and utilization.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for GS Paper III (Science & Tech) regarding power infrastructure, energy efficiency, and modern electronics. Frequently tested in Prelims via conceptual physics and application-based questions.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Alternating Current Direct Current.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
